scope: Read-only product and replay analysis; this report is the only authored artifact. No provider call; the one JavaScript regex probe ran under the existing offline guard.
conclusions: 15/16 natural confirmations fail: 11 fail with an exact UNIQUE_CURRENT reference because local whole-act grammar does not recognize them; 4 are conservatively blocked by AMBIGUOUS lifecycle context after earlier decisions were missed.

23/23 refusal checks fail: 12 UNIQUE_CURRENT, 7 AMBIGUOUS, 4 STALE_OR_SUPERSEDED. Eight terminal refusals depend on old-proposal selection that produced no candidate, so they are not independent refusal-recognition failures.

Every failed confirmation/refusal reached a USER_TURN HTTP exchange. The sole successful confirmation A04-T03 is local and has no such exchange. This supports missed local decision ownership, rather than a harness wait falsely hiding completed local decisions.

No REJECTED decision exists among 82 retained candidates in final sessions. retained.at(-1) did not demonstrably mask a successful rejection in this replay; its target-unbound assertion still overstates standalone refusal defects when the expected selection never existed.

UNIQUE_CURRENT is lifecycle uniqueness, not proof that the noun phrase in the new user message denotes that candidate. In A01-T15 and F02-T14 the old-proposal target is absent while a different correction is current. Widening matching without semantic target evidence risks rejecting the wrong candidate.

oracleAssessment.defect: Last-array-item status is not decision evidence bound to the expected target and current human turn. Lack of target after failed selection should be attributed as dependency blocked, not a new independent refusal defect.

genericOwnerRecommendations.proposal: Preserve exact lifecycle binding and fail-closed ambiguity. Recognize complete human decision scope only when referent evidence proves it denotes the entire currently presented candidate; distinguish scope to that candidate from partial approval of an attribute, quoted/hypothetical acts, negation and unrelated new assertions. Do not solve by scientific-noun lists or corpus phrase tables.

Resolve primary missed decisions before interpreting later AMBIGUOUS cascades. Old proposals require exact origin identity and current applicability; do not collapse several current candidates to most recent and do not substitute an unrelated unique current candidate.
Replace the demonstrated ASCII-style word-boundary assumption around accented suffixes with a Unicode-correct token boundary; validate independently of the observed corpus.

Bind rejection assertion to the exact expected candidateRef and a decision event produced by the current human turn. If prior selection did not produce the intended candidate, retain the primary selection failure and mark dependent rejection BLOCKED_BY_PRIOR_SELECTION_FAILURE.

safetyConstraints: No loosening of quote, hypothetical, negation, partial-scope or independent-payload safeguards from wave1.
No adoption inferred from candidate recency.
Do not infer language-provider capacity from synthetic offline transport.
